scope: M2 database API foundation: queries, typed mapping, structured errors, worker transactions; not full M2
notes: All checks ran locally in the agent shell with isolated PostgreSQL fixtures.
Transactions verified commit, statement failure rollback, deferred commit constraint failure, and abandoned transaction cleanup.
Commit timeout returns Commit_Unknown and discards the connection; no automatic retry.
Result-limit failures return empty safe-to-destroy results; Odin memory warnings are treated as failures in the database gate.
No new 30-minute soak or production qualification run.
Migrations, seeds CLI, general pool leasing outside HTTP workers, resource generation, and invoice CRUD remain later M2 work.
